author: Kevin Ertel
name: OpenInExplorer
description: Adds a module to reveal the selected images in the operating system's native file manager, with an option to create symbolic links in a chosen folder.
description-extensive: When you want to see where your photos actually live on disk, this add-on opens your computer's file manager (Finder on Mac, Explorer on Windows, or the Linux equivalent) with the selected pictures highlighted. It saves you from manually digging through folders to locate a file. It works on macOS, Windows, and Linux using their built-in file browsers.
